patterns: What kind of institute is RCCIIT?
responses: RCC Institute of Information Technology (RCCIIT) was established in 1999 by the Regional Computer Centre, Calcutta, as a joint venture of NIC, the Ministry of Communication & IT, Government of India, and the Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal. We are now administered by the State Government and operate from our Kolkata campus at Canal S Rd, Beleghata. We hold autonomous status and several of our programs are NBA-accredited.
We have been granted autonomous status by the UGC, hold NAAC accreditation (score 2.94 in the first cycle), and several of our undergraduate engineering programs are NBA-accredited.

patterns: How to get into RCCIIT through WBJEE?
responses:
B.Tech admission to RCCIIT is through the **WBJEEB (West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board)** counseling process:

4. Allotment is based on rank and category
